address: 2F, 20 Haiwen Road, Zhujiang New Town, Tianhe, Guangzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: The collaborative effort of two local restaurant brands focuses on local flavours and myriad techniques to make Cantonese food even better. Many diners come for the soups, which are double-boiled for at least four hours – expect deep umami but little grease. The steamed fish jaw with pickled young ginger and sweet soybean paste, and deep-fried chitterlings are also popular. Most seafood dishes are not on the menu – ask the server what is available.
